decisions.reason: Product A was demoted from its own page to a brief mention, signaling results below aspiration and triggering problemistic search for better uses of resources.
Product B is only briefly mentioned but is close to established lines, and no clear shortfall plus available slack allows the firm to carry it.
Product C has maintained its own page, indicating satisfactory results relative to aspirations and giving no reason to search for alternatives.
Product D has not received its own page but builds on established offerings, and its still-uncertain results can be absorbed by available slack.
Product E is only mentioned on the website, suggesting uncertain performance, but slack allows the firm to carry it for now.
Product F is newly launched with its own page, so results are still uncertain but promising, and slack supports keeping it.
